objectives: 本課程有系統性介紹如何觀察、描述於地表出露之岩石及岩體(沉積岩、火成岩及變質岩)的幾何位態與地質構造，特別強調野外地質實地考察及地質圖的判讀與製作。
content:
1. 野外地質的介紹

2. 面理與線理的幾何

3. 露頭位態與三點問題

4. 地質圖的判讀

5. 地質剖面

6. 立體投影

7. 褶皺的分類及投影

8. 斷層的幾何位態

9. 立體圖與地質圖

10. 野外地質實地考察
books:
Barnes, J.W., Lisle, R. J. (2004) Basic Geological Mapping (4th edition). John
Wiley ＆ Sons, 184 pp.
McClay K (1987) The Mapping of Geological Structures:Geological Society of London Handbook, Open University Press, John Wiley ＆ Sons.
Compton, R.R. (1985) Geology in the Field. John Wiley ＆ Son, 416 pp.
Rowland, S. M. ＆ Duebendorfer, E. M. (1994) Structural Analysis and Synthesis: A Laboratory Course in Structural Geology, 2 nd edition. Blackwell Scientific Publication.
Simpson, B. (1968) Geological Maps. Pergamaon Press.
